description: Code-behind for the TheoryExam page in an online examination system; handles loading questions, timing, and submitting answers to the database.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheoryExam ASP.NET page, managing question loading, timing, and answer submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; loads questions from database, initializes timer.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns course name based on course ID.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Stores answers in database, updates course queues, and marks course as taken.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates countdown timer display or indicates time out.
